purpose: Credential entry and in-place recovery from a rejected attempt
data_content: identifier + secret the user types; nothing is fetched
key_components: ds-screen, ds-field x2, ds-button primary, ds-link block, ds-banner error
notes: Entry point of the unauthenticated area. Success leaves this flow into the authenticated area — a boundary, not a route in this registry. proto-signin-01.

purpose: Request a reset link for an identifier
data_content: identifier carried forward from S-SIGN-01 when present
key_components: ds-screen, ds-toolbar back, ds-field, ds-button primary, ds-banner error
notes: No account-exists branch by design (D-f2) — a well-formed identifier always reaches S-SIGN-03. proto-signin-01.

purpose: Acknowledge the request and offer a throttled repeat
data_content: the identifier the link was sent to
key_components: ds-screen, ds-toolbar back, ds-button ghost, ds-link block, ds-banner success
notes: Reached by REPLACE, not push (D-f3) — hence its own explicit route back. proto-signin-01.
